content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Paragraph 9 of the APCN 2 Agreement (p0160–p0168) is the only regime conferring audit rights over our books and cost records. Classified as a **deviation**:

- **9.8 (p0167)** confers an unlimited right to review or audit with no frequency cap and no notice requirement; **9.9 (p0168)** only routes the right through the F&ASC's own procedures without supplying either limit. Unlimited, unannounced audits are walk-away territory, so the clause fails the fallback on two material terms.
- **Cost allocation is already at or above the fallback** — the audited Party recovers its entire reasonable compliance costs from the requesting Party, unconditionally and with no underpayment carve-out. Left verbatim; mapped as already_met.
- **Redline (fallback level):** one new 9.10 inserted after p0168 carrying only the two missing elements (once per calendar year; 15 days' prior written notice). 9.8 and 9.9 are untouched, so the cost mechanic and F&ASC channel remain intact.
- Preferred extras (30 days, business hours, independent auditor, confidentiality, off-site, no system access) were noted rather than pressed, since the audit right is mutual and benefits us as auditor. Paragraph 10.8's at-own-expense maintenance-records inspection right involves no access to our systems and was not flagged.
